title: Europe's three biggest industrial companies are cashing in on the AI boom, as Schneider and Siemens expand further into software, while ABB focuses on equipment (Aaron Kirchfeld/Financial Times)
summary: Aaron Kirchfeld / Financial Times: Europe's three biggest industrial companies are cashing in on the AI boom, as Schneider and Siemens expand further into software, while ABB focuses on equipment — Schneider Electric and Siemens move further into software as rival ABB bets on physical equipment
